Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator made a critical error in Step 1 by incorrectly stating a "GIVEN OR VERIFIED FACT" that "Clients with even-numbered addresses will be receiving the sunset awning design." This assumption was not provided in the original problem description; the problem only stated that even-numbered addresses face west and odd-numbered face east. By asserting this rule as a verified fact before analyzing the data, the Orchestrator introduced a false premise. This led the entire subsequent workflow (FileSurfer, Coder, ComputerTerminal) to count even-numbered addresses as the solution, rather than verifying the actual relationship between address parity, house orientation, and awning design (which might be the reverse or require explicit lookup). This mirrors the error pattern in Example 4, where an agent incorrectly assumed a data structure or rule without verification, leading to a flawed solution path.
